annotations.title: Exact day/unit Shapley attribution of a network's daily moves (paid)

description: Paid: 1.5 credits ($1.50) per answered call, charged once and only after a non-empty answer is computed; an unavailable answer, a refusal or an error costs nothing. Send your API key in the X-API-Key header or as api_key. Each call is a new answer and a new charge (no idempotency key). For one DePIN network: an exact two-factor functional ANOVA of the daily log changes of its stored first-party metrics over the last `days` complete UTC days (same input rules as get_rmt_regime_state), with factors day (moves shared by the network's metrics that day) and unit (metrics measured in the same unit; units held by one metric are pooled into one named group; a panel where a group would hold one metric, or that has only one unit group, is answered unavailable, uncharged). Returns each factor's variance share, their interaction and the metric-specific remainder, the mean absolute Shapley value per factor, and for the latest day each metric's change split exactly into its day and unit Shapley values plus remainder (additivity error reported). Descriptive: not causal, not a forecast. Uses up to `max_metrics` (3-60, default 30) metrics, by name order. Every input daily close is returned with its as_of and verify_url.

api_key.description: Your API key, only if your client cannot send the X-API-Key header.

days.description: Daily changes in the window (default 30), ending at the latest complete UTC day.

metric_filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of metric names, e.g. GPU.

symbol.description: One network ticker, e.g. AKT, FIL, RENDER.
